statusDefinitions.candidate: Code signal and Figma target each have source evidence; correspondence is a hypothesis pending live verification.
statusDefinitions.verified: Direct source-to-target correspondence is proven within explicitly recorded scope and date; this alone does not prove current publication, applicability, or variable bindings.
statusDefinitions.unresolved: Insufficient source evidence, missing target, structural mismatch, or unavailable published asset prevents a usable correspondence.

matchingContract.selectors: OR of simple CSS selectors, each selector matching all its tag/class/attribute conditions.
matchingContract.classes: OR of exact class tokens, not substring matches.
matchingContract.emptySignals: No automatic HTML match. Resolve using source component/snippet inventory and live inspection.
matchingContract.resultMeaning: A match is a discovery candidate, never evidence of a linked Figma instance. Match code.system against linked runtime styles and inspect source structure.
matchingContract.variantMeaning: code.variants are source Storybook example names or documented CSS modifiers, not a translation to figma.axes.
matchingContract.slotMeaning: Code slots are source snippet labels. Figma slots below are source-documented anatomy unless explicitly marked as an exposed property. They are not an automatic property mapping.

runtimeRequirements: Check source file hashes before trusting snapshot selectors or keys. A changed source requires reinspection.
Read source dates independently of generatedAt and verifiedAt. Undated source content has unknown freshness.
Check Code Connect when available, then existing product instances, then current library assets.
Verify platform, generation, published state, exact variant, exposed properties, variable modes and bindings before assembly.
Import a whole appropriate published organism before composing primitives. Component set keys are not interchangeable with component variant keys.
Do not auto-import from this registry. UNPUBLISHED targets are blocked until publication is confirmed live.
Preserve actual variant spelling. CSS literals or semantic names alone do not prove Figma token bindings.

requirements: Match local SVG path/name and exact native size.
Verify the component is still published and appropriate for platform and generation.
Prefer a semantic New icon; amenity icons use a thinner suitable drawing.
Match host IconContainer size exactly and verify semantic color binding after swap.
Do not replace an icon inside a published component unless an exposed instance-swap property permits it.

limitations: The initial registry has no verified HTML-to-Figma component correspondence. Matching names and known keys yield candidates only.
Coverage is a starter set, not a catalog of all controls, product organisms, states or responsive layouts.
Some BaseAI selectors are generated __auto-* classes; they are snapshot-specific and must be checked against source hashes.
Closed BaseAI overlay snippets often capture only the trigger button. They do not expose the rendered overlay DOM.
The legacy makedesign table names .btn, but current Base2.0/styles/components.css uses .button; actual runtime CSS takes precedence.
Product-specific facts, passport content, and task state matrices intentionally remain outside this shared map.
